output.title: Comment-only fix listed under Documentation; no runtime effect
output.content: The release note entry "Fix some comments" (#7620) appears under the v1.18.0 Documentation section. It describes comment edits only and names no behavior, API, value or CRD change. Nothing in the environment, including the cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate and the values keys set, can be affected by it. No operator action is needed.
